comment: Which sources make up the JavaScript in Resources/Public, and in which order.
The modules are concatenated in the order given here: init.js has to come first,
because it creates the OAP namespace the others extend, and the files under lib/ are
the third-party libraries the modules build on.
An entry that does not exist is skipped with a notice, so the list may already name a
module that a pending change will add.
The stylesheets are not built here - see Documentation/Build/README.md for the reason.
